agent_instructions.role: You are a Senior Android Engineer. Build FloraPulse: A specialized indoor plant care journal that uses your phone camera to analyze leaves for color changes, diagnosing watering, lighting, humidity, or nutrient issues instantly. Follow strict MVVM Clean Architecture with Room, Hilt, and Jetpack Compose.
code_standards: Jetpack Compose for all UI with fluid animations.
Room database for all local data persistence.
Hilt dependency injection throughout all layers.
WorkManager for background processing and notifications.
Google Play Billing 6.x for subscription and paywall.
Material Design 3 with app-specific premium theming.

dependencies.charts: Custom Compose Canvas charts OR com.github.PhilJay:MPAndroidChart

architecture.data_layer: Room DAO + Repository implementation + optional external API
architecture.domain_layer: Use cases encapsulating all business logic

ui_design.approach: Material Design 3 with custom color seed for this app category
ui_design.typography: Google Fonts — Inter for UI, specific accent fonts per category
ui_design.animations: Compose animate*AsState, AnimatedVisibility, Lottie for celebrations

execution_steps.step_1: Initialize project with Hilt, Room, Navigation Compose, DataStore.

execution_steps.step_2: Define all Room entities, DAOs, and database class for this app domain.

execution_steps.step_3: Build repository and use case layer with proper error handling via Result<>.

execution_steps.step_4: Implement primary feature screens with ViewModel state management.

execution_steps.step_5: Add notification/reminder system using WorkManager periodic tasks.

execution_steps.step_6: Build analytics/history screens with custom Compose Canvas charts.

execution_steps.step_7: Integrate Google Play Billing for premium subscription paywall.

execution_steps.step_8: Add onboarding screen, polish animations, complete app icon and store assets.
